pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions characterized by sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. The mid-flank displays larger, contiguous rectangular geometries, while the posterior flank exhibits smaller, more fragmented, and stellate shapes.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcate. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform on the neck and shoulder but becomes significantly thinner and more irregular on the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck mane, creating a bristled geometric contour against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark vertical linear feature is visible on the upper posterior flank, potentially representing a structural skin fold or a healed scar.
other_distinctive_markers: A small dark avian subject (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.
